svg.desc: System FMEA failure chains, sheet 1 of 6 (SFM rev 0.21): failure modes SFM-001 to SFM-004 (4 failure modes, 14 causes), each drawn as structure element, function, failure mode with severity, guideword and end effect, and its causes with occurrence, detection, Action Priority and actions.
svg.text: Figure 3-2 · System FMEA failure chains — sheet 1 of 6
SFM rev 0.21 · BL-005 · draft · SFM-001 … SFM-004 · 14 causes on this sheet
FAILURE CAUSE · O · D · AP · ACTIONS (STEPS 4–6)
F1 Lateral control: request steering torque
from the EPS to keep the vehicle in its lane
Steering torque applied when not engaged
End effect: Driver surprised during manual driving; possible lane
State machine reports active while disabled
Panda allows steering TX without valid engagement
Steering message packed with non-zero torque/request bit while
Steering torque or torque rate above limits
End effect: Lane departure or collision with adjacent traffic or
Lateral controller output too high (gain, torque model, saturation
Safety model torque/rate limits wrong for this vehicle or not
Wrong vehicle parameters (steer ratio, lateral accel factor, torque
Steering in the wrong direction (away from lane center)
End effect: Lane departure into oncoming/adjacent traffic or off
Calibration (camera extrinsics) wrong or not converged
Sign convention error in steering signal parse or pack for this car
Model desired curvature has wrong sign (corrupted frame, wrong
Insufficient lateral control (undershoot in curves, drift
End effect: Lane departure if the driver does not intervene
Safety model torque limit below what the curve requires (by design)
EPS limits or rejects torque request (EPS fault, torque limit,
Controller tuning or torque model too weak for vehicle state

S = severity of the failure mode (max of its effects); O / D = occurrence / detection of the cause; “in <element>” = structure element where the cause lies; “→” = linked failure mode in another FMEA; hazard = HARA hazard of an end effect.
